label: Research
heading: Three questions I keep returning to.
intro: The projects change; the questions are stubborn.

individual_card_details.heading: What leaves a catchment, and when
individual_card_details.text: Drought–rewet cycles flush years of stored carbon in a few days. I measure the flush, then test how much of it the models miss.

individual_card_details.heading: Where the road dust goes
individual_card_details.text: Tyre wear and brake dust carry metals and microplastics into rivers. Sediment cores show where they stop, and for how long.

individual_card_details.heading: Cheap sensors, honest uncertainty
individual_card_details.text: Low-cost loggers earn their place only if their drift is documented. I build the calibration routines that make that possible.

add_special_note.heading: How the group works
add_special_note.text: Every project starts with a blank field sheet and ends with raw data in the repository. If a method cannot be repeated by someone else, it is not finished.
